UI component wrapping a LanguageModelSelector to display and change the active inline assistant model, persisting selection to settings. Renders a popover trigger showing provider icon and model name, and toggles via a command-bound tooltip.

Crate entrypoint that wires agent UI modules, declares actions, initializes language model settings and features, and updates UI behavior based on AI settings. Defines ModelUsageContext helpers to access configured models and integrates inline assistants and panels.

Top-level context picker that offers modes (file, symbol, fetch, thread, rules) and actions to add context, managing recent entries and delegating to specific pickers. Builds and updates a popover menu, tracks subscriptions to stores, and routes selection to instantiate mode-specific pickers.

Observes extension lifecycle events to prompt configuration of context servers and remove settings on uninstall. Shows configuration modal for extensions and updates project settings via settings file writes.

Renders added and suggested context pills for the current prompt, including keyboard navigation across pills and focus management. Computes context summaries, suggests threads based on active editor, and integrates with ContextPicker and ModelUsageContext.

Prompt editor component for inline assistants and terminal assists that composes the editor, action handling, context strip, and model selector. Manages editor layout, codegen controls, input history, and action bindings for toggling menus and cycling results.

Generic language model selector using a Picker to list grouped recommended and other models per provider, with fuzzy filtering and live updates from LanguageModelRegistry. Authenticates providers in the background to populate models and handles selection/change callbacks.

Implements a ContextCreasesAddon to manage folded @context mentions in the editor, synchronizing with ContextStore to remove or restore creases and text. Also exposes ProfileProvider for threads to enable tool profile selection when supported by the model.

Profile selector UI that lets users pick agent profiles via a searchable picker and writes changes to settings, with a guarded state when tools aren’t supported by the active model. Lazily creates and refreshes its picker on settings changes and integrates with a popover trigger.

Completion provider for slash commands that fuzzy-matches command names, supports asynchronous argument completions with cancellation, and inserts or executes commands based on context. Integrates with editor selections and workspace to run commands upon confirmation.

Selector listing featured slash commands and optional adverts, with simple substring filtering and rich rendering with tooltips. On confirmation it inserts the chosen command into the active TextThreadEditor or triggers advert actions.

Streams model completions into a Terminal while preventing accidental execution, tracking status, message IDs, and providing undo/complete actions. Reports telemetry events with latency and errors and sanitizes terminal input to strip newlines and carriage returns.

Manages inline terminal assists by embedding a PromptEditor in the terminal view, building model requests with environment context, and orchestrating start/stop/finish flows. Maintains prompt history, integrates with ContextStore and PromptBuilder, and tracks telemetry.

Provides @mention completions for ACP message editors across files, symbols, threads, fetch URLs, and rules, generating link-like inserts with confirm callbacks. Includes path/symbol helpers, scoring, and integrates with Workspace and ContextStore to add context entries.

Maintains the UI state for ACP thread entries, creating and syncing editors, terminals, and diffs for user, assistant, and tool-call entries. Handles scroll anchoring for streamed thoughts and responds to font size changes for embedded editors.

Session mode selector that cycles and sets agent session modes via the AgentSessionModes API and renders a context menu with descriptions. Supports setting or unsetting the default mode using a modifier key and disables the trigger while updates are in flight.

ACP model selector that fetches and filters external agent models, watches for updates, and confirms selection to the agent. Groups models with separators and preserves selection state across refreshes.
Popover wrapper around the ACP model selector that shows the current model name/icon and toggles the picker with an action-bound tooltip. Exposes a method to read the active model name for display.
Displays agent thread history grouped into time buckets with fuzzy search, keyboard navigation, and auto-scrolling to the selected item. Emits events to open the selected history entry.

Modal to add an OpenAI-compatible provider by collecting API URL/key and model capabilities, validating input, and writing credentials and provider settings. Supports multiple model entries and enforces unique names and numeric limits.

Modal to configure context servers (custom or extension-provided) by editing JSON settings with optional schema validation, then writing to project settings. Resolves extension descriptors, optionally shows installation instructions, and supports editing existing servers.
Modal listing tools from a specific context server with expandable descriptions, providing a scrollable overview. Primarily a read-only UI surface with basic focus and dismissal control.

Modal workflow to create, select, view, and configure agent profiles, including enabling tools or MCP tools via ToolPicker. Integrates with AgentSettings and ToolWorkingSet, and provides navigable UI states with callbacks on dismiss.

Picker to enable or disable built-in and MCP tools per profile, grouping tools by source/server and updating settings accordingly. Supports filtering, non-selectable headers for context servers, and toggles selection state on confirm.

Context picker that fetches a URL via HTTP, detects content type (HTML, text, JSON), converts HTML to Markdown with specialized handlers, and adds the fetched content to the ContextStore. Provides a simple entry UI with duplicate detection and dismissal flow.

File/directory context picker using fuzzy path matching across visible worktrees, rendering entries with icons and 'added' state. On confirm it adds files or directories to the ContextStore and supports recent items when the query is empty.

Rules picker that searches user prompts from the PromptStore (excluding defaults) and adds selected rules to the ContextStore. Renders an 'added' indicator and integrates with the parent ContextPicker for dismissal.

Symbol context picker that searches project symbols, opens buffers to compute exact ranges, and adds symbol or enclosing ranges to the ContextStore. Includes logic to find matching DocumentSymbol and updates 'included' state after insertion.

Thread picker that searches existing threads and local text-thread contexts, then opens and adds the chosen entry to the ContextStore. Renders entries with 'added' status and merges results in reverse chronological order when no query is provided.

Onboarding modal introducing ACP integrations with actions to open the agent panel or view docs, instrumented with telemetry events. Provides a styled illustration layout and standard dismissal handling.

Lightweight notification window component positioned near the screen edge that displays title, caption, and actions to view or dismiss. Configures popup window options and emits acceptance/dismissal events.
Tooltip component describing Burn Mode with dynamic icon/state and keybinding hints, tailored to whether the mode is active. Presents concise explanatory copy with consistent styling.

Onboarding modal for the Claude Code integration that opens the panel to start a thread or links to documentation, with telemetry hooks. Mirrors ACP onboarding visuals with themed backgrounds and dismissal.

Reusable UI element for added or suggested context pills, rendering icons, labels, status (loading, warning, error), hover tooltips, and an optional remove button. Supports click handlers and subtle animations while handling duplicate-name display logic.
End-of-trial upsell banner card comparing Pro and Free plans with upgrade CTA and a dismiss control. Uses themed components to present plan benefits and integrates telemetry on interactions.
General agent onboarding modal promoting the agent panel and related blog post, with decorative backgrounds and telemetry. Handles focus, sizing relative to viewport, and standard dismissal pathways.

Callout component that warns when model usage is approaching or exceeding plan limits and provides contextual CTAs to upgrade or manage settings. Computes thresholds based on current plan and usage limits.
Small header component for profile modals that renders a title with an optional icon and consistent spacing. Provides a compact, themed header section for modal views.

Onboarding content showing configured non-Zed providers from the LanguageModelRegistry and a call to configure providers when none are found. Subscribes to provider registry changes to keep the list current.
Visual container component for onboarding content with elevation, background decoration, and a bordered panel area. Used to wrap various onboarding sections with consistent styling.

Composes agent panel onboarding by embedding Zed AI onboarding and conditionally adding API keys prompts when no providers are configured. Watches the provider registry and reads user plan state to tailor content.

Exports AI onboarding components and defines ZedAiOnboarding, which renders sign-in, free, trial, or pro experiences based on user status and plan. Includes SignInStatus mapping from client state and CTAs for trial and upgrades.

Upsell card presenting Free vs Pro plans with CTAs that adapt to sign-in and plan state, including young-account handling and decorative vectors. Provides optional tab index for integration and a sign-in callback.

Command-line tool to call embedded MCP tools (list_history, memory) via a Unix domain socket, resolving the socket path from CLI flags or a file. It builds and validates JSON arguments, performs JSON-RPC over the socket, and prints either raw JSON or distilled text from the response.

Client-side script that builds and maintains a page table of contents, syncing active links on scroll and click. It can auto-insert a side TOC if missing and updates the active state based on the last visible header.

Site enhancements including OS detection to render platform-specific keybindings, a theme toggle with persistence and system preference integration, and a 'copy markdown' button that fetches current page markdown and copies it to the clipboard with feedback toasts.

Zed extension that locates or installs the glsl_analyzer language server by downloading the latest GitHub release for the current platform, caching the binary, and wiring up workspace configuration. It ensures executable permissions and cleans old versions.

Zed extension for the HTML language server that prefers a system binary but can install a Node-based server via npm, caching and validating the installed path. It sets initialization options (e.g., provideFormatter) and forwards workspace LSP settings.

Zed extension that resolves the protobuf-language-server binary from explicit settings or PATH and constructs its command-line invocation. It supports passing configured arguments and errors when not found.

Example extension implementing two slash commands (echo, pick-one) with argument completion and simple structured outputs. It demonstrates validation, immediate execution on selection, and labeled output sections.

Test extension that exercises the extension API by performing filesystem operations, spawning a child process, downloading release artifacts, and returning a language server command. It also customizes completion labels with code snippets and highlighted spans.

DangerJS script enforcing PR hygiene by checking for release notes, suggesting proper issue linkage syntax, and requiring attestations for prompt and fixture changes. It posts warnings or fails PRs accordingly.

Utility script that fetches GitHub release notes by tag, converts markdown to simple HTML (handling lists and code fences), and prepends an entry to the Flatpak release info file for a channel. It escapes HTML and handles empty lines and links.

Script that queries GitHub for top-liked open issues by category, optionally since a date, and compiles a ranked markdown report. It can update a target issue body or print results, tracking API usage and timing.

Shared types and constants for the Zed perf profiler, including test importance levels, failure kinds, test metadata, timings, and an Output aggregator with sorting and merging logic. It defines the protocol used by proc-macro-instrumented tests.

Perf profiler binary that builds and runs instrumented tests, parses test metadata, iteratively increases iterations based on noise thresholds, and logs results as markdown or JSON. It can compare two saved runs by aggregating per-crate JSON files.

xtask command that runs cargo clippy across a package or the workspace with strict settings (release, all targets/features) and optionally applies fixes, failing on any warnings. It prints the full command line and propagates errors.

xtask that scans workspace packages for adherence to shared lints and flags non-workspace dependencies (excluding extensions and certain packages). It reads each Cargo.toml and reports packages using non-inherited dependencies.

Defines agent conversation entries (user messages, assistant chunks, tool calls) with rendering to markdown, tracking of diffs and terminals, and resolution of tool call locations within the project. It bridges protocol-level tool calls to UI-friendly structures and state updates.

Tracks buffers affected by tool actions, maintains diffs against a base, and emits unified-diff patches for unnotified user edits while responding to buffer edit and file events. It integrates with the project and LSP to register buffers and updates diffs asynchronously.

Represents a conversation thread for the legacy agent with message IDs, segments (text, thinking, redacted thinking), token usage accounting, checkpoints, and retry strategies. It converts messages to model-ready content and manages display semantics.

Native agent orchestration that manages sessions pairing internal Threads with AcpThreads, builds and refreshes project context, and aggregates language models across providers with background authentication and grouped model lists. It listens for project, model, and prompt store changes and persists session state.

Core thread logic for the new agent defining user and agent messages (text, images, mentions), request conversion with rich contextual tags, and retry strategies for completions. It supports 'resume' prompts and structured markdown rendering for conversation content.

Agent-side edit_file tool integrating authorization checks for sensitive paths, resolving project-relative paths, and updating tool call UI metadata and locations. It invokes EditAgent with model-specific formats and streams events/results back to the tool call.

UI for configuring language model providers and context servers, dynamically constructing per-provider configuration views and reflecting authentication/plan status. It tracks expanded sections, listens to registry/context server updates, and exposes actions to open new threads.

Diff pane that displays and navigates agent-proposed changes by syncing excerpts from the ActionLog into a multibuffer editor with hunk controls. It reacts to AcpThread events, updates the title, and manages focus and folding for deleted files.

Central agent panel wiring workspace actions to create threads, open history/settings, and handle menus while integrating with feature flags and onboarding flows. It switches between external agent thread views, text threads, history, and configuration UIs.

Manages inline code generation within buffers, orchestrating a primary and alternative model streams, tracking diffs, edit positions, and elapsed times per alternative. It emits events for UI updates and supports cycling, undo, and start/stop of generation.

Global inline assistant manager that registers per-workspace hooks, injects a code action provider, handles lifecycle of inline assists across editors and terminals, and cancels active predictions when AI is disabled. It coordinates with the AgentPanel and settings.

Editor-based UI for text threads that integrates slash command completion, language model selection, image/dragged file handling, and display of thought processes and command outputs. It manages creases, scrolling, and project-aware LSP behavior for the context buffer.

Message editor for ACP threads supporting mentions via a context picker, slash command hints as inlays, and media attachments. It emits focus/send events, maintains a set of resolved mentions, and integrates with history and prompt stores.

Comprehensive ACP thread view rendering messages, tool calls, plans, and usage with controls for mode/model/profile selection, feedback, and error handling. It manages expansion states, notifications, diff panes, and interactions with the underlying AcpThread and agent server.

Completion provider powering the context picker for mentions, searching files, symbols, threads, rules, or URLs based on mode and recent entries. It ranks results, builds completion items with labels/icons, and handles cancellation and workspace context.

Core assistant context store handling message insertion/updates, summary generation state, slash command lifecycle, and buffer operations with serialization to/from proto. It integrates with models and client telemetry, providing structured operations and statuses.

EditAgent coordinates LLM-driven file edits by crafting prompts from templates, streaming and parsing edit outputs (create/overwrite/edit), and applying changes to buffers while updating ActionLog and emitting granular events. It resolves edit ranges, handles ambiguities, and reports parser metrics.

Tool wrapper exposing the edit_file operation with JSON schema and contextual UI text, enforcing authorization for sensitive paths and resolving project paths. It initializes an EditAgent, streams progress to a UI card, and returns structured results or diffs.

Evaluation suite for the edit agent that constructs scripted conversations and asserts diffs or outputs across scenarios, optionally parameterized by model. It measures pass rates and uses fixtures to validate multi-hunk edits and transformations.
Test fixture implementing a simplified ActionLog and diff maintenance used by edit agent evaluations. It simulates tracking created/modified buffers and updating diffs on edits and file changes.
Large editor module fixture copied for evaluation scenarios to test editor-related behaviors like blinking, diffs, and UI integration. It is not production code and serves only as test input.

Extensive fixture source representing a language configuration and build workflow used in an eval scenario for transforming tooling (e.g., switching from Emscripten to WASI SDK). It provides realistic input for the edit agent tests.

Implements asynchronous diffing between a buffer and a base text, producing hunks with ranges and secondary statuses, and supporting staging/unstaging against a secondary diff. It manages snapshots, pending hunks, and integrates with GPUI task labels for background computation.

Manages a collaborative call room backed by LiveKit, tracking participants, connection status, project sharing/joining, and event emission. It handles joins/leaves, reconnection, pending updates, and integrates with audio, client messaging, and UI tasks.

Core client managing credentials, settings, and a websocket connection to the cloud server with reconnection/backoff, status broadcasting, and action handlers. It provides message routing, telemetry integration, and helpers for proxy settings and environment overrides.

Test fixture simulating digraph entry in Replace mode using ctrl-k sequences and exiting with escape to verify composed characters are inserted correctly. Validates final buffer state and mode transition.
Exercises the '.' mark navigation by performing an edit, then jumping to the last change using backtick and dot. Ensures the mark resolves to the correct position after edits.
Validates the repeat command '.' across inserts, deletions, yanks, motions, and case toggling with counts. Ensures repeated actions reproduce prior changes consistently across lines.
Checks 'dw' deletion behavior at end-of-line with wrap and limited columns, ensuring word deletion respects line boundaries. Verifies the resulting buffer and cursor position.
Verifies 'G' motion to the end of the document across varying buffer states, including empty leading lines and truncated content. Ensures repeated 'G' remains stable at the end.
Tests 'g_' motion to the last non-blank of subsequent lines, including counts. Confirms correct downward movement and placement on each target line.
Validates '$' motion with counts to move to end-of-line across multiple lines. Ensures cursor lands at the proper line ends sequentially.
Checks Enter in Normal mode moves the cursor to the first non-blank of the next line. Ensures behavior is consistent regardless of initial cursor position mid-word.
Exercises Visual Line selections with shift-v and deletion via 'x', including edge cases with empty lines. Validates selection ranges, deletion behavior, and mode transitions.
Tests Visual mode selections across words and lines, toggling selection endpoints with 'o' and re-entering Visual after escape. Also checks interactions switching to VisualBlock and back.
Ensures pressing escape while waiting for a register name (after '"') cancels the pending operation cleanly. Subsequent 'x' behaves normally, confirming robust modal handling.
Validates 'ct<' change-till motion in the presence of multibyte UTF-8 characters. Ensures correct text change and cursor placement with non-ASCII content.
Uses manual folding ('zf') to create a fold, navigates and yanks inside, then opens the fold ('zo'). Confirms fold boundaries, registers, and motions operate correctly within folds.
Regression-style fold test ensuring deletions and Visual Line operations across folded regions do not panic. Verifies stability at buffer ends and fold transitions.
Checks 'dv$' forced visual motion deletes to end-of-line from various positions. Confirms buffer content and mode remain consistent after the operation.
Validates 'dv0' deletes to the start of the line from different cursor positions. Ensures correct deletion range and final cursor placement.
Tests yanking with forced motion ('yvj') and pasting ('p') across lines and positions. Confirms duplicated content and registers are updated appropriately.
Verifies 'gg' moves to the first line and works with counts (e.g., '2gg') under diverse buffer states. Ensures consistent placement at the target line start.
Exercises 'gi' to return to the last insert position and resume insert mode. Validates that subsequent input is applied at the correct historical point.
Tests 'gn' to select the next search match, including repeated selections, backward selection with 'gN', and deletion of the match. Validates Visual ranges and counts.
Validates formatting with 'gqq' and 'gq' over Visual selections using a set textwidth. Ensures line wrapping and cursor positioning match Vim behavior.
Checks 'gv' to reselect the last Visual selection, including toggling between Visual and VisualBlock contexts. Ensures re-selection anchors are preserved.
Tests leftward motion 'h' at line starts and across lines, confirming boundary handling. Ensures no movement when already at the line start.
Validates 'h' movement across wide Unicode box-drawing characters. Ensures correct indexing over grapheme clusters and multi-column characters.
Exercises horizontal scroll commands ('zL', 'zh', 'zl') with nowrap and column constraints. Verifies viewport shifts without moving the cursor.
Checks deletion using 'dve' to ensure exclusive end-of-word behavior from forced visual motion. Validates that the end character is not removed unexpectedly.
Tests increment/decrement (ctrl-a/ctrl-x) on integers with counts and dot-repeat, including negative transitions. Confirms numeric parsing and repeat behavior.
Validates binary number handling for increments, including wrap-around and zero padding. Ensures ctrl-x reverses increments appropriately.
Ensures hex increments normalize casing consistently (e.g., 0xFa → 0xfb). Verifies consecutive increments behave predictably.
Checks hex wrap-around behavior with long numbers and zero-padding on increment. Confirms decrement restores intermediate padded forms.
Exercises numeric increment within mixed alphanumeric tokens, moving the cursor and incrementing different embedded numbers. Confirms partial-token arithmetic updates.
Validates radix-aware increments for hex and binary, sign changes, and non-numeric text handling. Ensures case-sensitive hex formatting on decrement.
Checks sign transitions when decrementing zero and subsequent increments with counts. Ensures numeric state updates are consistent.
Validates preservation of leading zeros during sign changes on decrement and restoration on increment. Ensures formatting remains stable.
Exercises 'g ctrl-a' and 'g ctrl-x' for stepped increments across Visual selections and blocks, including counts. Confirms multi-line arithmetic and block operations.
Tests incrementing parts of a number via Visual and VisualBlock selections, duplicating lines and adjusting values. Ensures partial numeric updates aggregate correctly.
Checks transitions across boundaries (0999 → 1000) and decrement paths while maintaining appropriate zero padding. Validates arithmetic consistency.
Validates increments in numbers containing dots, ensuring the correct digit is modified. Confirms decrement restores prior value.
Ensures increments and decrements preserve leading zeros on numbers. Confirms count-based decrement behavior.
Tests increments on numbers with leading zeros and zero values, including decrement resulting in zero-padding changes. Confirms formatting stability.
Checks numeric increment in strings with multiple dots, selecting the appropriate numeric part. Ensures decrement behaves predictably.
Validates 64-bit integer wrap-around behavior on large increments and decrements. Ensures transitions between positive and negative extremes match Vim semantics.
Applies repeated decrements with a count to a zero-padded number. Ensures padding remains correct after multi-step operations.
Tests indenting a Visual selection with '>' and using 'gv' to reselect. Ensures highlighting and indentation reflect the operation.
Validates Insert-mode ctrl-r to paste from registers, including invalid register sequences and escape behavior. Ensures buffer and mode stay consistent.
Checks Insert-mode ctrl-y and ctrl-e to pull characters from adjacent lines. Ensures correct character insertion and cursor position.
Exercises 'A' to append at the end-of-line across different positions and lines. Ensures Insert mode begins at the correct line end.
Validates 'I' to insert at the first non-whitespace character across varied line contents, including blanks. Confirms correct insertion point and mode.
Tests 'O' to insert a new line above in different contexts. Ensures new line placement and entry into Insert mode behave properly.
Checks counts with insertion commands (i, a, I, A, o, O), repeating typed characters or lines appropriately. Ensures escape returns to Normal with expected content.
Validates repeat '.' after insertions and open-line commands with counts, including non-insert keystrokes like 'k'. Ensures repeated actions match prior edits.
Tests downward motion 'j' across plain text and multibyte emoji, ensuring proper column tracking and line boundary behavior. Confirms no movement at buffer end.
Verifies an Insert-mode mapping 'jk' to escape, confirming that typed characters and mode switching behave as intended. Ensures mapping does not corrupt buffer state.
Exercises line join operations with 'J' and 'gJ', both with counts and in Visual mode. Validates spacing rules and concatenation across multiple lines.
Validates jump list behavior with large motions and navigation via ctrl-o and ctrl-i. Ensures positions are recorded and restored correctly.
Checks 'G' motion to end-of-buffer across various buffers and confirms idempotency. Includes cases with empty trailing lines and mid-buffer movement.
Tests '^' to jump to the first non-blank character across normal, blank, and space-only lines. Ensures movement stays on the same line when applicable.
Validates '$' and '0' motions for end and start of lines under diverse cursor positions. Ensures no movement when already at boundaries.
Tests upward motion 'k' across lines and from varied positions, including boundaries. Ensures correct movement and behavior when at the buffer top.
Checks rightward motion 'l' within and across lines, including no-op when at line end. Validates correct column advancement.
Tests setting a lowercase mark and jumping to it using line ('') and exact ('`') motions. Validates deletions to a mark and correct mark resolution.
Exercises visual selection boundary marks '<' and '>' and jumping to them via both line and exact motions. Validates selection anchoring and mark behavior after edits.
Validates setting and using marks for navigation and deletion across lines. Ensures marks track exact vs line positions correctly.
Tests '%' matching across parentheses, braces, brackets, and nested constructs, including movement between paired delimiters. Ensures match behavior in code-like contexts.
Validates '%' matching inside JSX-like tags with attribute brace content. Ensures pairing navigates inside complex tag structures.
With html filetype set, tests '%' matching across HTML tags including self-closing elements and multi-line attributes. Ensures correct jumps between opening and closing tags.
Checks 'vi b' to select inner text of parentheses ignoring trailing spaces and yanks it. Validates selection range and register content.
Tests named registers for delete/yank ('"a') and paste, reading register contents after operations. Confirms correct text stored and pasted from specific registers.
Simple integration-style test performing insert and 'dw' to delete a word. Validates basic editing flow and Normal/Insert mode transitions.
Verifies Enter moves to the start of the next line in Normal mode. Confirms cursor placement relative to indentation.
Checks motion to the next word or structural boundary when the last character is a newline-adjacent delimiter. Ensures cursor lands at the expected closing character.
Tests 'o' to insert a new line below across various positions and contexts, including mid-buffer and near empty lines. Ensures proper line insertion and entry into Insert mode.
With rust filetype, verifies 'o' and 'O' continue comment leaders automatically. Ensures inserted lines carry correct comment markers and mode transitions.

Changes worktrees to default is_complete to false and adds completed_scan_id. It refines completion tracking with explicit scan references.
Creates followers table linking leader/follower connections across servers with indexes and uniqueness constraints. It models follow relationships for collaborative sessions.
Introduces worktree_repositories table keyed by project/worktree/work_directory with branch, scan_id, and is_deleted, plus indexes. It tracks repository associations within worktrees.
Adds worktree_repository_statuses table for per-repo path status with scan_id and deletion flags, with layered indexes. It stores granular repository status snapshots.
Creates worktree_settings_files table storing per-worktree settings content keyed by path, with relevant indexes. It persists editor configuration within projects.
Adds a git_status column to worktree_entries, simplifying repository status representation. It moves away from separate status tables.
Adds is_external boolean to worktree_entries with default false. It flags entries originating outside the core project.
Creates feature_flags and user_features tables with unique and foreign key constraints and supporting indexes. It enables server-side feature flagging per user.
Establishes channel_messages and channel_chat_participants tables with indexes and relationships. It forms the basis of channel chat message storage and participant tracking.
Adds observed_buffer_edits and observed_channel_messages tables to track per-user observed state with unique indexes. It supports synchronization and change observation logic.
Adds participant_index integer to room_participants. It orders or identifies participants within a room.
Creates notification_kinds and notifications tables with indexes spanning recipient, read state, kind, and entity. It provides a system for user notifications.
Adds an enviroment text column to rooms. It stores environment metadata for rooms.
Adds a unique index on rooms.channel_id. It enforces one-to-one mapping between rooms and channels.
Adds role to channel_members and sets channels.visibility default, with data migration of roles. It introduces guest/admin/member role handling and channel visibility.
Alters projects.room_id foreign key to cascade on delete. It ensures dependent projects are removed when rooms are deleted.
Creates channel_message_mentions table and replaces nonce index with a per-sender-and-nonce unique index. It enables mention ranges and reduces nonce collisions.
Adds parent_path to channels, backfills from channel_paths, and indexes it. It denormalizes path hierarchy into the channels table.
Adds role text column to room_participants. It captures participant roles within rooms.
Adds environment text column to rooms to correct naming. It standardizes room environment metadata.
Adds impersonated_user_id to access_tokens. It supports token-based impersonation for administrative or support functions.
Creates a contributors table keyed by user_id with signed_at timestamp. It tracks contributor agreements or sign-offs.
Adds requires_zed_cla boolean to channels with default false. It gates participation based on contributor license agreement status.
Recreates the index on channels.parent_path using text_pattern_ops. It optimizes prefix-based path queries.
Adds reply_to_message_id to channel_messages. It supports message threading or replies.
Adds in_call boolean to room_participants with default false. It tracks call participation state.
Drops enviroment and environment from rooms and in_call from room_participants. It cleans up unused schema fields.
Creates extensions and extension_versions tables with indexes, including trigram search on names and download counters. It models an extension registry with version metadata.
Creates rate_buckets keyed by user and rate_limit_name with token counts and timestamps plus index. It enables per-user rate limiting storage.
Adds edited_at timestamp to channel_messages. It records message edits for auditing or display.
Creates hosted_projects with channel-scoped unique names and soft-delete support, plus indexes. It formalizes hosted project entities tied to channels.
Adds a unique partial index on channels(parent_path, name) when parent_path is present. It enforces hierarchical uniqueness of channel names.
Allows projects.host_user_id to be NULL and adds hosted_project_id referencing hosted_projects with a unique constraint. It links projects to hosted entities.

Denormalizes latest buffer operation epoch, lamport timestamp, and replica_id into buffers and backfills via DISTINCT ON selection. It improves read performance by avoiding joins for latest op metadata.
Database migration enforcing non-null roles for channel_members and removing the legacy admin column to streamline membership semantics.
Sets channels.parent_path to NOT NULL to enforce hierarchical integrity for channels.
Adds schema_version to extension_versions to track extension schema compatibility.
Introduces dev_servers with authentication via hashed tokens and links to channels, establishing a foundation for remote development servers.
Adds wasm_api_version to extension_versions to record the WASM API compatibility of extensions.
Creates remote_projects tied to dev_servers and channels, and references them from projects, enabling remote project linkage.
Creates an embeddings table keyed by model and digest with a 1536-dimension vector and retrieval timestamp to cache vector embeddings for retrieval.
Reworks dev_servers to be owned by users instead of channels and removes channel_id from remote_projects, resetting related data.
Removes name from remote_projects and enforces uniqueness of (dev_server_id, path) to prevent duplicates.
Replaces remote_projects with dev_server_projects, migrates data, enforces unique (dev_server_id, path), and links projects via dev_server_project_id.
Drops projects.remote_project_id and the remote_projects table after migration to dev_server_projects.
Adds ssh_connection_string to dev_servers to store connection details.
Adds JSONB paths to dev_server_projects, backfills from existing path values, and makes the single path field optional to support multiple worktrees.
Introduces billing_subscriptions with Stripe identifiers, status, timestamps, and indexes to manage user subscription records.
Adds last_stripe_event_id fields to billing_customers and billing_subscriptions to track processed Stripe events.
Removes last_stripe_event_id columns and creates processed_stripe_events for idempotent handling and auditing of Stripe webhook events.
Adds stripe_cancel_at to billing_subscriptions to record scheduled cancellation time.
Adds accepted_tos_at to users to track terms of service acceptance.
Adds github_user_created_at to users to record the origin account creation time from GitHub.
Adds enabled_for_all boolean to feature_flags to support global rollouts.
Enforces NOT NULL and a unique index on users.github_user_id to ensure uniqueness of linked GitHub accounts.
Adds is_fifo to worktree_entries to correctly classify FIFO special files.
Adds a kind column to worktree_settings_files to distinguish different settings file types.
Introduces billing_preferences per user with a max monthly LLM spending limit and a uniqueness constraint on user_id.
Adds canonical_path to worktree_entries and sets a default for is_symlink to improve symlink metadata.
Adds custom_llm_monthly_allowance_in_cents to users to override default LLM usage allowances.
Removes dev server related columns and drops hosted_projects, dev_server_projects, and dev_servers, decommissioning the remote dev infrastructure.
Creates a breakpoints table linked to projects and worktrees with position, path, kind, and an index for project-based querying.
Adds stripe_cancellation_reason to billing_subscriptions to record cancellation context.
Expands worktree_repository_statuses with status_kind and detailed first/second status fields, backfilling and enforcing NOT NULL for status_kind.
Adds a name column to users to store display names.
Adds has_overdue_invoices to billing_customers to flag delinquent accounts.
Adds a set of provides_* capability flags to extension_versions to declare extension-provided features (themes, grammars, servers, etc.).
Adds current_merge_conflicts to worktree_repositories to track active merge conflict state.
Adds a nullable VARCHAR column to worktree_repositories to store additional repository status details.
Adds branch_summary to worktree_repositories to persist computed branch information.
Extends billing_subscriptions with a kind and Stripe period start/end in epoch seconds for billing cycle tracking.
Adds trial_started_at to billing_customers to track trial activation timing.
Adds head_commit_details to project_repositories to cache metadata about the current head commit.
Extends billing_preferences with overage controls and spend limits for model requests beyond included quotas.
Adds channel_order to channels, populates it deterministically via ROW_NUMBER partitioned by parent_path, and indexes for efficient ordered queries.
Adds committer_name and committer_email to project_collaborators to attribute commits.
Adds provides_debug_adapters to extension_versions to advertise debug adapter support.
Cleans orphaned repository records and adds validated ON DELETE CASCADE FKs to project_repositories and project_repository_statuses to enforce referential integrity.
Updates access_tokens FK to cascade deletes when a user is removed.
Adds a capabilities text column to language_servers to store advertised protocol capabilities, removing the default after creation.
Sets users.admin to NOT NULL to ensure explicit admin state.
Adds orb_customer_id to billing_customers to integrate with Orb billing.
Drops the obsolete rate_buckets table.
Adds merge_message to project_repositories to record merge commit messages.
Adds orb_subscription_id to billing_subscriptions for Orb integration.
Makes Stripe subscription ID and status optional in billing_subscriptions to support non-Stripe billing flows.
Adds Orb subscription status and current billing period timestamps to billing_subscriptions.
Adds worktree_id to language_servers to scope server instances to a specific worktree.
Adds orb_cancellation_date to billing_subscriptions to record cancellation time in Orb.
Adds orb_portal_url to billing_customers to store the self-service billing portal link.
Adds windows_paths flag to projects to control path style handling on Windows.
Adds token_spend_in_cents and its update timestamp to billing_subscriptions for tracking token-based charges.
Creates providers and models tables with rate limit fields and indexes, establishing the catalog of LLM providers and models.
Defines usage_measures and per-user usages with bucketed counts and uniqueness constraints to track consumption.
Converts model rate limit columns to bigint to support higher limits.
Adds per-million token pricing columns for input and output to models.
Adds is_staff flag to usages to differentiate staff usage.
Creates lifetime_usages to persist cumulative input/output tokens per user and model with a uniqueness constraint.
Introduces revoked_access_tokens to track invalidated JWTs by jti with a unique index.
Adds pricing and counters for cache creation and cache read tokens across models, usages, and lifetime_usages.
Removes erroneously added cache token columns from usages.
Creates monthly_usages with per-user/model token counters for a given month and year and enforces uniqueness.
Defines billing_events with idempotency keys and token counters to log billable usage, with indexing on user and model.
Adds separate max_input_tokens_per_minute and max_output_tokens_per_minute to models for granular throttling.
Creates subscription_usages to track per-period usage metrics like model requests and edit predictions with uniqueness per user and period.
Adds plan to subscription_usages and indexes it to segment usage by subscription plan.
Introduces subscription_usage_meters tied to subscription_usages and models, tracking request counts.
Adds mode to subscription_usage_meters and updates uniqueness to include mode.
Drops legacy subscription usage and meter tables as part of schema cleanup.
Removes monthly_usages and lifetime_usages tables, consolidating usage tracking elsewhere.
Drops the billing_events table as part of data model simplification.
Environment configuration for production deployment, setting logging, invite link prefix, auto-join channel, and database connection limits.
Environment configuration for staging deployment including logging, invite link prefix, auto-join channel, and DB connection caps.
Template that instructs an evaluator to analyze a repository diff against an assertion and return structured XML with analysis and pass/fail.
Template for evaluating a conversation's messages and tool calls against an assertion, producing XML analysis and a pass flag.
Example evaluation configuration defining a scenario and assertions to detect hallucinated tool use by an agent.
Defines the GitHub interface for extensions, including release types and a function to fetch the latest release with filtering options.
Defines the platform interface exposing OS and architecture enums and a function to query the current platform.
Versioned GitHub interface specification for extensions, mirroring release types and latest release retrieval.
Versioned platform interface providing OS/architecture enums and a current-platform function.
GitHub interface specification for v0.0.6, defining release models and latest release retrieval.
Node.js interface for extensions providing node binary path, NPM package queries, and install operations.
Platform interface for v0.0.6 exposing OS and architecture and a function to get the current platform.
Common interface defining a simple half-open range type for use across extension APIs.
Node.js extension API v0.1.0 offering node binary discovery and NPM package management capabilities.
Platform extension API v0.1.0 exposing OS and architecture and current-platform querying.
Common interface v0.2.0 retaining the range type for shared use in APIs.
Node.js interface v0.2.0 for package queries and installation and node binary path retrieval.
Platform interface v0.2.0 with OS/architecture enums and a current-platform function.
Common interface v0.3.0 adding env-vars tuples alongside the range type for process/environment APIs.
Node.js interface v0.3.0 for extensions supporting npm version queries, installation, and node path discovery.
Platform interface v0.3.0 describing OS/architecture and current-platform retrieval.
Process interface enabling extensions to run commands with environment variables and collect stdout/stderr and exit status.
